instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Retire the copy I recorded by hand when the transcript already kept the same reply", naming the copy's message id, the transcript reply's message id, the evidence, and the rows read from the store.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:retire-a-copied-ai-reply and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read the answer: correction is the record of the retirement; keep lists each row to change as { id, type, value, expected }. Store each row whose expected still matches; a value of null retires the row.
